children: CarGurus has appointed Matthew Mandel as its new chief financial officer, effective Oct. 19.
Mandel brings to the online automotive marketplace a wealth of experience, most recently as CFO and chief operating officer of Fleetio, a fleet maintenance and optimization software platform.
Before Fleetio, he was COO and then co-chief executive at beverage technology company Cometeer.

He succeeds chief executive Jason Trevisan, who served as interim principal financial and accounting officer since March of last year. Trevisan has been chief executive officer of the company since 2021.
